name: PushRelay
author: pushrelay

sections.description:
PushRelay brings modern web push notifications directly into WordPress without external dashboards,
manual service worker configuration, or complex setup.

This plugin is designed to feel native to WordPress while leveraging the full power of the PushRelay
infrastructure.

Current focus:
* Simple API connection validation
* Automatic readiness checks
* Foundation for advanced push automation

Future updates will expand automation, segmentation, and WooCommerce integrations.

Short Description

Native push notifications for WordPress powered by PushRelay.

External Services

This plugin connects to the PushRelay API to enable push notification functionality.

Service provided by:
PushRelay — https://pushrelay.com

What data is sent:
* Website identifiers
* API authentication token (provided by the site administrator)

When data is sent:
* When validating the API connection
* When initializing push notification services

Why data is sent:
* To register the website
* To enable delivery of push notifications

Terms of Service:
https://pushrelay.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://pushrelay.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → PushRelay.
  4. Enter your PushRelay API Key.
  5. Save settings and verify connection status.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

You can obtain your API key from your PushRelay account dashboard at https://pushrelay.com.

Does this plugin send notifications automatically?

Not yet. Version 1.2.0 provides the foundation and connection layer.
Automation features will be introduced in upcoming versions.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce integration will be optional and added later.
